_comment: Invrisil 8c Task C1 (issue #12) -- ~14x10 Brothers' parlor (hideout interior, 'borrowed elegance': shabby-genteel, one absurdly good rug, warm low light over the card table). biome brothers_parlor (see biomes.json's own _comment for the already-present-asset picks). Border blocked on every edge except the single door gap at (0,4) (the door entity's own cell is never double-counted in `blocked` -- entity occupancy alone suffices, the liscor_gate/garden_door precedent verified against this exact codebase before writing this). THE GUEST COUCH sits at (2,7), Wilovan greets at (6,3), the card table + rug anchor the room's center (6,5)/(6,6) -- see each entity/decor entry's own _comment for the render-bbox math.

entities._comment: Round-trip pair with alleys_to_parlor (mercantile_alleys cell 19,12). This is the parlor's ONLY exit -- a dead-end hideout interior, matching witch_hollow's own single-purpose-room shape one map further in.

Invrisil 8c Task C1 -- Wilovan, CANON (wiki.wanderinginn.com/Wilovan, WIKI-VERIFIED 2026-07-08, same verification C2's combatant record already banked): a Gnoll [Thug] of the Brothers of Serendipitous Meetings, brick-built, dapper vest/leggings/tall hat, gentlemanly courtesy -- 'perfect gentlemen. Until the hats come off.' The plan's User-ratified shape 1 (WILOVAN fronts the Brothers, supersedes the dialogue-drafts lane's ORIGINAL 'Mister Sable' -- that draft's register informs a background Brother, never fronts). talk_pool + static dialogue fallback ONLY, NO `conversation` key: the commission/ways/marker quest graph (docs/design/dialogue-drafts/invrisil/brothers_lieutenant.json, recast Sable->Wilovan at wiring time) is Task C3's own deliverable (it starts the `a_gentlemans_disagreement` quest, which does not exist in quests.json yet -- wiring it now would fail test_content's quest_ids assert). Sprite: reused `pc_gnoll_m` rig tinted dapper vest/hat colors (dark green + brass), zero new generation -- the hats-off violence tell is staged at CONTENT time (C3), not art time.
entities.observe: A Gnoll in a vest cut sharper than his manners need to be, tall hat squared like it's holding a rank. He watches the room's exits before he watches you.
entities.friendly_line: He inclines the hat half an inch — a genuine courtesy, not a performance of one. "A pleasure," he says, and seems to mean it.
talk_pool: Evening. Might I say, sir, you carry yourself like a person things happen to. We collect a few of those.
Manners cost nothing and buy everything, in my experience. Mind the rug — Normen fusses over it more than he'll admit.
You'll notice the hat stays on. Best we keep it that way, between friends.
We don't steal, whatever you've heard. We RECOVER. It's a finer distinction than it sounds, and it's the whole of our business.

dialogue.speaker: Wilovan
dialogue.text: Evening, sir. Fine weather for good behavior.

entities._comment: THE BED RULE (standing, plan's user-ratified shape 3): the parlor's guest couch, sleep:true, unconditional once the parlor is reachable (no quest gate -- reaching this room already required the door chain: portal -> boulevard -> alleys door -> parlor door, no shortcut exists). Reuses the EXISTING `bed` sprite verbatim (Interior_Props_01.png, frame 34x44, render_scale 0.375, default anchor [0.5,1.0]) -- the SAME already-shipped asset the inn's own bed uses, not a new pick: rendered footprint is ~12.75px wide / ~16.5px tall, i.e. it overhangs its OWN cell's north edge by well under 1px and stays fully inside its own cell on every other axis (measured against CELL=16px) -- functionally self-contained, the lowest-risk placement shape available, chosen specifically to satisfy the render-bbox placement discipline (the Riverfarm cot lesson) without a windowed check. Cell (2,7) is deep interior (open per the border-blocked computation above), 4 cells from Wilovan (6,3) and 4 cells from the table (6,5) -- no neighbor decor shares (2,6)/(2,8)/(1,7)/(3,7), so the sub-1px north overhang lands on bare floor.
entities.sleep_toast: Even a couch here fits like it was fitted for you. The Brothers do nothing halfway, not even hospitality.
